sloka: द्विजेन्द्रपक्षवातेन द्रावितं दृश्य पूर्वजम् ।सुमाली स्वबलैः सार्धं लङ्कामभिमुखो ययौ ।। ७.८.१९ ॥
transliteration: dvijendrapakṣavātena drāvitaṁ dṛśya pūrvajam ।sumālī svabalaiḥ sārdhaṁ laṅkāmabhimukho yayau ।। 7.8.19 ॥

translations.english: Seeing his elder brother (Malyavan) driven away by the wind from Garuda's wings, Sumali, along with his own forces, headed towards Lanka.
